title: Ultra Deck - The Three Captains
note: Copiado da optcgapi.com para os testes e para o primeiro início do servidor. A importação (npm run cards:import) tem prioridade sobre estes dados.

cards.name: Trafalgar Law
cards.text: [Activate:Main] [Once Per Turn] DON!! -3 (You may return the specified number of DON!! cards from your field to your DON!! deck.): Place up to 1 of your opponent's Characters with 3000 power or less at the bottom of the owner's deck, and play up to 1 Character card with a cost of 4 or less from your hand.

cards.name: Monkey.D.Luffy
cards.text: [Activate:Main] [Once Per Turn] If you have 0 DON!! cards on your field or 8 or more DON!! cards on your field, add up to 1 DON!! card from your DON!! deck and set it as active.

cards.name: Eustass"Captain"Kid
cards.text: [Your Turn] If you have 4 or more Life cards, give this Leader -1000 power. [When Attacking] DON!! -1 (You may return the specified number of DON!! cards from your field to your DON!! deck.): This Leader gains +2000 power during this turn.

cards.name: Sanji
cards.text: [On Play] If your opponent has a Character with 5000 or more power, this Character gains [Rush] during this turn. (This card can attack on the turn in which it is played.)

cards.name: Jinbe
cards.text: [DON!! x1] [When Attacking] Give up to 1 of your opponent's Characters -2000 power during this turn.

cards.name: Monkey.D.Luffy
cards.text: [Rush] (This card can attack on the turn in which it is played.) [Once Per Turn] When your opponent activates a [Blocker], K.O. up to 1 of your opponent's Characters with 8000 power or less.

cards.name: Killer
cards.text: [Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When a DON!! card on your field is returned to your DON!! deck, K.O. up to 1 of your opponent's rested Characters with a cost of 3 or less.

cards.name: Shachi & Penguin
cards.text: [On Play] If you have 3 or less DON!! cards on your field, add up to 2 DON!! cards from your DON!! deck and rest them.

cards.name: Jean Bart
cards.text: [On Play] ① (You may rest the specified number of DON!! cards in your cost area.): Add up to 1 DON!! card from your DON!! deck and set it as active.

cards.name: Trafalgar Law
cards.text: [Blocker] (After your opponent declares an attack, you may rest this card to make it the new target of the attack.) [On Play] DON!! -1 (You may return the specified number of DON!! cards from your field to your DON!! deck.): If your opponent has 7 or more cards in their hand, trash 2 cards from your opponent's hand.

cards.name: Heat
cards.text: [Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When a DON!! card on your field is returned to your DON!! deck, this Character gains +2000 power until the start of your next turn.

cards.name: Bepo
cards.text: [On Play] / [When Attacking] If your opponent has more DON!! cards on their field than you, add up to 1 DON!! card from your DON!! deck and rest it.

cards.name: Eustass"Captain"Kid
cards.text: [On Play] / [When Attacking] DON!! -1 (You may return the specified number of DON!! cards from your field to your DON!! deck.): Up to 1 of your Leader gains +1000 power until the start of your next turn.

cards.name: Wire
cards.text: [Blocker] (After your opponent declares an attack, you may rest this card to make it the new target of the attack.) [Once Per Turn] When a DON!! card on your field is returned to your DON!! deck, draw 1 card and trash 1 card from your hand.

cards.name: Gum-Gum Giant Sumo Slap
cards.text: [Counter] Up to 1 of your Leader or Character cards gains +2000 power during this battle, and K.O. up to 1 of your opponent's Characters with 2000 power or less.

cards.name: Gum-Gum Kong Gatling
cards.text: [Main] K.O. up to 1 of your opponent's Characters with 7000 power or less.
cards.trigger: Up to 1 of your Leader gains +1000 power until the end of your next turn.

cards.name: Punk Vise
cards.text: [Main] Rest up to 1 of your opponent's Characters with a cost of 2 or less, and add up to 1 DON!! card from your DON!! deck and rest it.
cards.trigger: Add up to 1 DON!! card from your DON!! deck and set it as active.
